title: NeuralEcho MACS high-density communication-related EEG dataset
description: This dataset comprises high-density EEG recordings from 30 healthy, right-handed, native Chinese-speaking adults performing imagined and executed vocalization and writing tasks involving Chinese strokes and English letters. The factorial design crosses task mode, action, script, and token identity, yielding 32 event-coded conditions across 15,360 task events. The dataset is intended to support research on motor imagery and execution related to language production and communication.
methods_description: Each participant completed eight runs of 64 trials in a factorial design crossing task mode (motor imagery or motor execution), action (read/speak or write), script (Chinese or English), and token identity. High-density EEG was recorded using a 127-channel cap layout with bilateral mastoid electrodes (M1, M2) as reference; electrode coordinates follow the EEGLAB ALS convention. Raw BrainVision EEG data and metadata are provided in BIDS format, with proprietary Neuroscan source recordings and EEGLAB preprocessing derivatives available separately.
